title: Catalog view
responsibility: Lists the selected category of project entities with text search, a changed-only filter and sorting.

inputs.name: CatalogView.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplying the current category, optional project snapshot and entity-card context. A missing snapshot contributes an empty entity list. The category must be nonempty because it is used to build the heading.

outputs.name: CatalogView
outputs.description: Category heading, project breadcrumb, filters and matching entity cards. Search starts empty and matches displayed names and summaries without case sensitivity; changed-only starts off. Sorting defaults to name, or uses descending string order of design versions, treating missing versions as empty. Displays an empty-view message when no entities match.

dependencies.contract: The shared Select component supplies keyboard and value selection behavior through the $shared alias.
